Verified Local Jewelry Leads

CaratBase delivers verified local leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers—people who want to sell gold, get an appraisal, or purchase an engagement ring. The first three leads are free; each accepted lead thereafter costs $40, and a valuation widget is available for $29 / month.

What You Get

  • Verified, local prospects – leads are screened for intent and location, ensuring they are ready to engage with your business.
  • No upfront account setup – start receiving leads immediately after the free trial.
  • U.S.-focused coverage – leads come from customers in your metro area, beginning with Atlanta and expanding to other regions.
  • Optional valuation widget – embed a gold‑valuation tool on your website for $29 / month to attract additional traffic and capture leads directly.

How It Works

  1. Sign up – provide basic contact information; no lengthy onboarding is required.
  2. Receive leads – after the three‑lead free trial, each qualified lead is delivered to you for $40 once you accept it.
  3. Convert – contact the prospect promptly to discuss selling gold, arranging an appraisal, or selling an engagement ring.
  4. Scale – as CaratBase expands to more metros, you’ll gain access to a broader pool of local buyers and sellers.

Why Choose CaratBase

  • Local relevance – leads are matched to your specific service area, reducing travel time and increasing conversion odds.
  • Cost‑transparent pricing – you only pay for leads you accept, with a clear $40 per lead after the free trial.
  • Built for independents – the platform is designed for small‑to‑medium jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers who need a steady flow of qualified customers without large marketing budgets.
  • Additional lead capture – the valuation widget turns website visitors into leads, giving you another channel to grow your client base.

FAQ

Does CaratBase provide verified local jewelry leads? Yes. All leads are screened for intent and location, ensuring they are genuine prospects in your service area.

What is the pricing structure? The first three leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. The optional valuation widget for your website is $29 per month.

Can I use CaratBase if I’m not in Atlanta yet? CaratBase currently launches in Atlanta first and is expanding to additional U.S. metros. You can sign up now and will receive leads in the markets where the service is active.

Next Step

Ready to start receiving qualified local jewelry leads? Visit caratbase.com/verified-local-jewelry-leads to claim your free leads and grow your business today.
